items.title: Document asset layering and compatibility contract
items.context: Define project-local required assets versus package registry prompt templates versus generated/cache materialization, including legacy mirror compatibility and no-overwrite rules.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `rg -n "registry-backed prompt assets|project-local required|legacy mirror compatibility|STALE_LOCAL_EDIT" docs/requirements/decisions/lifecycle-artifact-scope.md` 后看到四个命中行。

happy.desc: Docs define project-local required assets, package registry prompt templates, generated/materialized caches, and legacy mirror compatibility.

edge.desc: Docs explicitly preserve legacy full-mode .Codex/.claude mirrors and explain thin mode is opt-in, not a silent default migration.

adversarial.desc: Docs state migration must not overwrite or delete local edits unless Koala can prove STALE_SAFE ownership.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "registry-backed prompt assets|project-local required assets|legacy mirror compatibility|STALE_LOCAL_EDIT|production authority" docs/requirements/decisions/lifecycle-artifact-scope.md
verificationEvidence.note: Docs define project-local assets, package registry prompt templates, materialized prompt caches, and legacy mirror compatibility.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "legacy mirror compatibility|Thin-mode repositories may omit|Legacy full-mode repositories may keep" docs/requirements/decisions/lifecycle-artifact-scope.md
verificationEvidence.note: Docs preserve legacy full-mode mirrors and state thin mode omits prompt copies only when manifest selects registry prompts.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "STALE_LOCAL_EDIT|report-only|must not overwrite or delete local edits" docs/requirements/decisions/lifecycle-artifact-scope.md
verificationEvidence.note: Docs require report-only handling for local edits, case mismatch, and incompatible prompt files during thin migration.

items.title: Implement package prompt registry and host renderer
items.context: Expose versioned agent prompt metadata, template hashes, and host-specific rendering for Claude and Codex without changing legacy prompt files yet.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `npm --prefix packages/main run test:prompt-registry-smoke` 后看到 `✓ prompt registry smoke passed: 16 agents rendered for claude and codex`。

happy.desc: Registry enumerates every package template agent with stable id, path, sha256 hash, and host render outputs.

edge.desc: Registry behaves deterministically when template directory exists through package templates rather than repo-local .claude symlinks.

adversarial.desc: Codex rendered output remains byte-compatible with the legacy renderCodexAgentContent transform so legacy mirrors are not silently changed.

verificationEvidence.note: Prompt registry smoke enumerated 16 package agents with stable metadata and host render outputs.
Smoke used the package templates/agents registry root and did not depend on repo-local .claude symlink materialization.
Smoke compared Codex registry rendering against the legacy renderCodexAgentContent transform for every prompt.

items.title: Make Codex verification and managed asset checks registry-aware
items.context: Allow legacy mirror mode and new registry mode to pass hard verification, preserving existing process-event gate evidence and clear drift diagnostics.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `node packages/main/dist/tasks/codex-registry-mode-smoke.js` 后看到 `✓ codex registry mode smoke passed: legacy mirror and thin registry verification are both covered`。

happy.desc: Legacy manifest or absent promptMode keeps existing .claude/.Codex mirror hard check behavior.

edge.desc: Registry promptMode verifies registry version/hash/renderability without requiring local prompt mirror directories.

adversarial.desc: Registry hash mismatch or missing registry capability fails clearly and still preserves hard Codex adapter verification semantics.

verificationEvidence.note: Codex registry mode smoke verified the legacy manifest path still uses the hard agents-mirror check.
Codex registry mode smoke verified promptMode=registry passes without .Codex/agents or .claude/agents prompt mirror directories.
Codex registry mode smoke tampered promptRegistry.materialHash and observed a hard manifest failure while registry renderability remained separately checked.

items.title: Add opt-in thin init asset mode
items.context: Support init/check paths that keep project assets lightweight by writing manifests and launchers while avoiding default prompt copies when registry mode is selected.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `lattice init --asset-mode=thin --profile=codex` 后，初始化输出说明 thin/registry mode，项目中没有 .Codex/agents prompt copies，但 check 和 verify 仍能通过。

happy.desc: Thin codex init writes manifest/launcher/docs and omits .Codex/agents prompt copies.

edge.desc: Full init remains the default compatibility behavior and still materializes legacy prompt assets.

adversarial.desc: Thin check/apply does not delete user-owned local prompt files or overclaim production authority.

verificationEvidence.note: Thin init smoke ran real init with --profile=codex --asset-mode=thin, verified registry manifest/README, absence of .Codex/agents, managed asset check, and Codex adapter verification.
Thin init smoke ran default full Codex init and verified it still materializes the package prompt copies in .Codex/agents with a legacy manifest.
Thin init smoke seeded a user-owned .Codex/agents/user-owned.md before --asset-mode thin and verified init/check/verify left it in place.

items.title: Validate legacy compatibility and thin mode behavior
items.context: Run focused smoke tests, build/type checks, init fixtures, managed asset checks, and Codex adapter verification proving existing full mode is unaffected.
items.userSees: 用户看到验证摘要包含 `✓ prompt registry smoke passed`、`✓ codex registry mode smoke passed`、`✓ thin init assets smoke passed`、`✓ build passed` 和 `✓ Codex adapter checks passed`。

happy.desc: Focused smoke commands and TypeScript build pass in the story worktree.

edge.desc: Legacy full-mode check/verify behavior remains covered after registry mode additions.

adversarial.desc: Codex adapter verification process-event evidence is refreshed after touching Codex adapter material paths.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:prompt-registry-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:codex-registry-mode-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:thin-init-assets-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: TypeScript build and all three focused smoke commands passed in the story worktree after the thin/full init changes.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:codex-registry-mode-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:thin-init-assets-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Registry-mode smoke covers legacy mirror verification, while thin-init smoke proves full init remains the default and still materializes .Codex/agents prompt copies.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/utils run build && KOALA_SESSION_ID=sess-984e0c8ad2c9b71f node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex
verificationEvidence.note: Codex adapter verification passed 6/7 checks with manifest, 16 mirrored prompts, local wrapper heartbeat, exclusions, and aux availability; the only warning was that global koala points at the main checkout and is heartbeat-only.
